Name: Fishstick Fish
Author: CacklingxCaracal
Description:
Fish of the Valley have been turned into fishsticks, rings, and patties and are catchable only in the season of winter. This ADDS bonus fish and does NOT replace vanilla fish. In a fish pond they will give their vanilla counterpart. 

They require the same time and location as their vanilla fish, but are not limited by weather condition (and legendary fish are catchable at different fishing levels as you progress)

No AI was used at any point during the making of this mod  - 100% human suffering certified! 
I do not give permission for any AI translation of this mod. Human translations are always welcome!

Also has a toggle for if you have my Vegan Fish mod to add their frozen variants.
